correctness.rationale: For every n>=5, the 3n four-vertex open neighborhoods are the unique tetrahedral facets. Each designated pair of same-fiber vertices has a unique common graph neighbor, proving every deletion is of a free face. The two 3n-step phases leave the parity-even planar triangular tiling modulo a rank-two translation lattice, hence a torus. The standalone verifier exhaustively checks collapses and manifold links for 5<=n<=40. No finite extrapolation is needed for the uniform proof.
